dashboard.label: Review
dashboard.description: Run health, clusters that were too large to merge, and assets whose sources disagree.

search.query: | inputlookup assetdb_runs | sort 0 -run_time | head 20 | eval run_time=strftime(run_time, "%F %T") | table run_time status assets_out assets_prev rows_in null_keys overflow_assets junk_keys enrich_unmatched enrich_ambiguous

panel.title: Clusters too large to merge (from the last run)

html.p: Each row is a group of assets that chained together through shared keys into more than Max Keys keys, so it was left out of the asset database. This is usually one shared key (a NAT address, a golden image host name): add it to the Key Blocklist on the Settings tab. asset shows up to 20 of the keys.

search.query: | inputlookup assetdb_overflow | sort 0 -cluster_rows | table asset cluster_keys cluster_rows source source_lookup

html.p: What the last runs added, removed or changed (needs Change History on the Settings tab set to the KV store collection; in index mode search sourcetype=assetdb:change). An asset whose keys change shows up as removed and added.

search.query: | inputlookup assetdb_changes | sort 0 -run_time | head 200 | eval run_time=strftime(run_time, "%F %T") | table run_time change asset changed_fields asset_id

html.p: Fields marked Flag Conflicts that had more than one different value across the sources of an asset (first 200 assets).

search.query: | inputlookup assetdb | search conflicts=* | head 200 | table _key asset conflicts source
